bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
chat=-1002373696859;topic=4291;oldid=4633
ledger=Path("deploy/state/startless-recover-missing-topic4291-20261122.json")
if ledger.exists() or ledger.is_symlink():sys.exit(62)
q=f"SELECT message_id,state,pinned,CASE WHEN token_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{{64}}$' THEN 'hash_ok' ELSE 'bad' END FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id={chat} AND message_thread_id={topic}"
r=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-At","-F","|","-c",q],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
if r.returncode or r.stdout.strip()!=f"{oldid}|published|t|hash_ok":sys.exit(63)
q=f"SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id={chat} AND message_thread_id={topic} AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL"
r=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-At","-c",q],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
if r.returncode or r.stdout.strip()!="1":sys.exit(64)
u=subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py","--chat-id",str(chat),"--topic-id",str(topic)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
if u.returncode:sys.exit(65)
d=[json.loads(z.split("=",1)[1]) for z in u.stdout.splitlines() if z.startswith("USERBOT_TOPIC_AUDIT=")]
if len(d)!=1 or len(d[0].get("rows",[]))!=1:sys.exit(66)
row=d[0]["rows"][0]
if row.get("topic_id")!=topic or (row.get("migration") or {})!={"message_id":oldid,"transport":"NOT_FOUND"}:sys.exit(67)
if row.get("post_button")!="ABSENT" or row.get("pin_state")!="ABSENT_FROM_PINS" or row.get("history_inspected",0)<1:sys.exit(68)
print("TOPIC4291_REPAIR_PREFLIGHT=PASS")
PY
